title.value: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law
title.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law.

location.provenance: Be it enacted by the People of the State of Illinois, represented in the General Assembly:

reference.provenance: SB0088 Introduced 1/20/2023, by Sen. Laura Fine

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemical" means any of the perfluoroalkyl substances or polyfluoroalkyl substances included in the United States Environmental Protection Agency's expanded ToxCast chemical inventory.

type.provenance: Provides that on and after specified dates, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State specified products that contain intentionally added PFAS chemicals.

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical:

who.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State

products.provenance: any product in any of the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: (1) Carpets or rugs. (2) Fabric treatments. (3) Food packaging. (4) Juvenile products. (5) Oil and gas products. (6) Apparel.

type.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in the State that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals in the handle of the product or in any product surface that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the product label

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in the State

who.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in the State

action.provenance: shall list the presence of PFAS chemicals on the product label

products.provenance: a PFAS manufacturer of cookware sold in the State that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals in the handle of the product or in any product surface that comes into contact with food, foodstuffs, or beverages

value: Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements: (1) The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements of subsection (f) to be affixed to the item. (2) The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed. (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached.
exceptions.provenance: Cookware is exempt from this Section if it meets all of the following requirements: (1) The surface area of the cookware is not large enough for a product label that meets the requirements of subsection (f) to be affixed to the item. (2) The cookware does not have any of the following: (A) An exterior container or wrapper upon which a product label can appear or be affixed. (B) A tag or label to which information about the cookware may be attached.
